<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW22ykMMYap3WBMUhHviqhAoA)_

Stacked on #26, which edits the same function. Merge #26 first and GitHub retargets this one to `main`.

**Before:** `emacs-pr` had no built-in usage text. `emacs-pr --help` would have tried to fetch a pull request called `--help`.

**After:** `emacs-pr --help`, `-h`, `help` or no argument prints the commands, the folders a sandbox uses (worktree, home, seed, native-compile cache), the matching `M-x` commands, the requirements and a pointer to the README section. The README usage block lists the flag, and the changelog has an entry.

**How it was checked:** `fish -n` passes, and in fish all four forms print the text and the longest line is 91 columns. The rest of the function is unchanged.

---
